newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic sees NYNEX deal by April 22.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic sees NYNEX deal by April 22.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp Chairman Raymond Smith said Tuesday he is confident the merger with NYNEX Corp will be completed by April 22.
"I think the merger will definitely be completed by April 22," Smith said at the Millennium Conference in San Francisco.
He said almost all regulatory hurdles have been cleared and the Justice Department, one of the last steps before the merger can be completed, is expected to approve the deal within a couple of weeks.
U.S. telecommunications giants NYNEX and Bell Atlantic agreed in April last year to merge, forming the second-largest U.S. telecommunications company under the Bell Atlantic name.
